description: Continue a previous Antigravity session by session_id (returned by every other tool). USE THIS for follow-up questions about a prior delegation — the full prior context is already on agy's side, so you don't resend anything.

cwd.description: Absolute path to the working directory / project root. Defaults to the server's cwd.

model.description: Override the model: a name or id from `agy models`, or a `*` version pattern such as "Gemini * Pro (High)". Normally omit — the tool routes automatically.

session_id.description: The session id returned by a previous agy-bridge call.

name: follow_up
